cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your solo debut may proceed once you've asked your understudy for the opening line.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you cue me without telling everyone I forgot it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I authorize a discreet rescue. First, acknowledge that you need me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you. Quietly. They're listening at the curtain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for discretion is granted. Lean toward me; I shouldn't have to raise my voice to save your opening night.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 private cue request causes A3 conditional discreet rescue; B4 admission and listeners cause A5 quiet, closer delivery terms.

relationship.evidence: B2 fears public embarrassment and B4 cooperates while preserving discretion, a credible performer's priority.

heightening.evidence: B4 meets A's demand; A5 honors the requested privacy while retaining superior control over how help is delivered.
